certification_profile.status: Confirmed by Meridian FedRAMP program office 2026-07-06

executive_summary.narrative: This Ongoing Certification Report (OCR) covers the period ending 2026-08-15. The Meridian LMS maintains a 76.1% compliance rate across 46 Key Security Indicators with 11 active gaps. Persistent validation is demonstrated through 2114 KSI validation runs and 357 daily evidence snapshots. The VDR pipeline tracks 100 vulnerabilities with 0 accepted.

transformative_changes.note: All monitored change events have been classified as routine_recurring. No transformative changes have occurred.

certification_data_changes.narrative: During this reporting period the FedRAMP Certification Data for the Meridian LMS was updated by 195 recorded change events (all classified under the CR26 SCN change types) and 2114 automated KSI validation runs. Effective this period, all Certification Data was migrated to the FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026 (v2026.09.13.02): 46 CR26 Key Security Indicators, FRR rule-family compliance validations, and the confirmed Certification Profile (20x · Program · Class C).

reportable_incidents.attestation: No FedRAMP Reportable Incidents occurred during this reporting period (CCM-OCR-AVL). Incident evaluation and communication procedures per FRR-IEC remain in place and are persistently validated by the incident automation pipeline.

agencies_direct_use.public_note: Per CCM-OCR-LSI (Limit Sensitive Information) and CCM-OCR-RPS (Responsible Public Sharing), the list of agencies directly using the cloud service offering is not included in this public copy. The full agency list is supplied with the Ongoing Certification Report distributed to all necessary parties as FedRAMP Certification Data (CDS rules).

feedback_mechanism.note: Per CCM-OCR-FBM this channel is available to all necessary parties; per CCM-OCR-AFS an anonymized feedback summary accompanies each report, and raw agency feedback is not disclosed publicly (CCM-OCR-LSI).

CCM-OCR-AVL.description: Providers MUST supply an Ongoing Certification Report to all necessary parties every 3 months, covering the entire period since the previous summary, in a consistent format that is human readable

CCM-OCR-SOR.description: Providers SHOULD establish a regular 3 month cycle for Ongoing Certification Reports that is spread out from the beginning, middle, or end of each quarter

CCM-OCR-NRD.description: Providers MUST supply the target date for their next Ongoing Certification Report with other public FedRAMP Certification Data

CCM-OCR-FBM.description: Providers MUST supply an asynchronous mechanism for all necessary parties to provide feedback or ask questions about each Ongoing Certification Report

CCM-OCR-AFS.description: Providers MUST supply an anonymized and desensitized summary of the feedback, questions, and answers about each Ongoing Certification Report

CCM-OCR-LSI.description: Providers MUST NOT irresponsibly disclose sensitive information in an Ongoing Certification Report that would likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering

CCM-OCR-RPS.description: Providers MAY responsibly supply some or all of the information in an Ongoing Certification Report to the public if doing so will NOT likely have an adverse effect
